items.html: And after the two years of the Yenika, when the two aforementioned brains grew — they themselves through the milk, as above — behold, the power of the milk expanded and was drawn downward into the seven lower Sefirot, which are his VAK and the Nukva, Malchut, which is the seventh; and they too grew. And this was in the course of seven more years; and if you join them with the first two years, they are nine years.
